episodes.synopsis: Two years have passed since the events at JuLai. Vash is still missing. Someone is stealing Plants again.
episodes.title: Wandering Days

episodes.synopsis: When their home is attacked, Vash is the last hope for Brad, Jessica, and the others.
episodes.title: Unforgiven

episodes.synopsis: The immediate threat is suppressed, but now there is no doubt that the threat from Knives is still real.
episodes.title: Memento Mori

episodes.synopsis: Vash sets off for Home with his companions, but Knives' men are already planning a new attack.
episodes.title: From Order to Chaos

episodes.synopsis: Midvalley attacks Home and faces off against Wolfwood.
episodes.title: What a Wonderful World

episodes.synopsis: Everyone prepares for a huge battle as Legato and the Ark approaches Ship 3.
episodes.title: The Darkest Hour Is Just Before the Dawn

episodes.synopsis: As the arrival of the fleet imminent, both factions begin preparations for the final showdown.
episodes.title: The Hurt Locker

episodes.synopsis: Wolfwood helps Vash break out of the Ark, but is pursued by Razlo, Livio's alter ego.
episodes.title: Good Bye, My Friend

episodes.synopsis: The crew, with its latest new member Livio, regroup at Hopeland to kick off their plan to stop Knives.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Vash and Knives, and their respective allies, face off in a final showdown at the crash site where it all started.

episodes.synopsis: Knives arrives and captures Vash. His final plan is set in motion - as well as Vash's final resistance.
episodes.title: I Miss You.

episodes.synopsis: The immigrant fleet arrives, and Knives single-handedly threatens to eliminate them.
episodes.title: QUO VADIS
